Planning a trip to Queenstown, New Zealand? This video covers some of the BEST adventure and relaxation experiences you can do in the adventure capital of New Zealand!
In this episode of our New Zealand South Island road trip, we explore the thrill, beauty, and luxury side of Queenstown while celebrating our anniversary
We started our day with one of the craziest adventure activities in New Zealand — the famous Hydro Attack experience A shark-shaped submarine-style jet boat that dives underwater, jumps vertically out of the water, and moves like a fighter jet!
